subject: planner: fix index merge shouldn't push partial limit down when index plans are keep ordered (#52979)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent: adjusts `PhysicalLimit.Attach2Task` for IndexMerge(union) to avoid pushing a partial Limit to the table/probe side when `cop.keepOrder` is true (handles may be reordered before table scan), falling back to keeping the Limit above IndexMerge or embedding it when safe. Adds an integration plan+result regression for issue #52947 (ordered IndexMerge with MIN/MAX). No remaining Blocker/High issues found; upstream/master retains the same keepOrder guard logic.
